title: Least Number of Unique Integers after K Removals
summary: Given an array of integers and a count k, determine the minimum number of distinct integers remaining after removing exactly k elements.
statement: Given an array of integers and a count k, determine the minimum number of distinct integers remaining after removing exactly k elements.
constraints: Return the minimum possible number of distinct integers remaining.
reference_solution:
def least_unique_after_removals(arr, k):
 from collections import Counter
 frequencies=sorted(Counter(arr).values());remaining=len(frequencies)
 for count in frequencies:
  if count>k:break
  k-=count;remaining-=1
 return remaining

hints: Count occurrences of every distinct value.
Removing all occurrences of a value is the only way to reduce the distinct count.
Spend removals on frequencies from smallest upward while affordable.
This greedy order eliminates the most distinct values per removal; leftover partial removal cannot reduce the count.
